contracts.commit_point: conn.commit() at tools.py:165 inside save_ticket_summary, where the INSERT OR IGNORE into tickets (lines 121-127), the upsert into ticket_metadata (lines 130-148), and the INSERT into ticket_messages (lines 151-163) become durable.
contracts.declared_mechanism: Deterministic identity gate in archivist_node ('No ID, No Archive', archivist.py:40-45): if state.user_id is falsy the node returns {"archive_summary": "Skipped: User is anonymous."} and never reaches archivist_agent.invoke (archivist.py:66). archivist_agent is created via create_agent with tools=ARCHIVIST_TOOLS (archivist.py:23-33) and ARCHIVIST_TOOLS = [save_ticket_summary] (tools.py:174), making the guarded node the only supplied invocation path to the committing tool; workflow.py registers archivist as a graph node (line 56) and routes all terminal paths through it before END (lines 99-103).
